title: Horton Fall 2019 Finals 1: Hermit/Sewers, Bridge, Diplomat, Outpost
quality_note: Designer explains the Hermit/Sewers opening and ranks three build paths from playtesting; two players lost with the Madman/Bridge megaturn.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule: players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening. Played with the 2018-2019 Hermit wording: when you discard it from play, if you didn't buy any cards this turn, trash it and gain a Madman (it is trashed, so trash triggers fire).

edition: 2019 rules: pre-errata Hermit (trashes itself for Madman), which the Sewers trick relies on.
